mainPage.thanksText: First of all, I'm really glad to have you here

generalSection.title: General
generalSection.nameText: Hi! My name is Vladyslav Boychuk (Vlad)
generalSection.descriptionP1: Professional developer with years of experience crafting software solutions for Industry 4.0 and an engineer at heart, no matter the field.
generalSection.descriptionP2: Balance is the key. That's why, even though I have experience in both backend and frontend development, I choose to focus on the latter. This allows me to blend two seemingly opposite skill sets, combining technical expertise with creative design to deliver well-rounded, innovative solutions.
generalSection.descriptionP3: A good product shouldn't just work—it should feel intuitive and enjoyable for the person using it.
generalSection.englishTooltip: Officially, my level is B2, but I feel very comfortable communicating in English. Many of my friends don’t speak any of my native languages, so we've been using English for years. Plus, I handle most of my tech-related searches and training in English, which gives me access to more information, helps me learn new vocabulary, and lets me get plenty of practice
